sourceNotice: 依据 textbook.md 中标明的原创任务导读生成，不是教材逐字原文；个人经历与开放任务须自行完成。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Think about the city where you live.
lines.chinese: 想一想你居住的城市。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Which actions make it a nicer place?
lines.chinese: 哪些行动能让它变得更美好？

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Choose helpful actions from the list.
lines.chinese: 从清单中选出有益的行动。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Add an idea of your own.
lines.chinese: 补充一个自己的想法。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Collect litter and put it in a bin.
lines.chinese: 捡起垃圾，把它放进垃圾桶。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Keep flowers growing in the park.
lines.chinese: 让花朵留在公园里生长。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Repair something instead of throwing it away.
lines.chinese: 修好物品，而不是把它扔掉。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Say what you will and will not do.
lines.chinese: 说说你会做什么、不会做什么。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Make a list of resources to save.
lines.chinese: 列出你要节约的资源。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Plan a greener way to live.
lines.chinese: 规划更环保的生活方式。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Discuss your ideas with a classmate.
lines.chinese: 和同学讨论你的想法。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Ask for another useful suggestion.
lines.chinese: 再问一个有用的建议。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Look at the used materials and new objects.
lines.chinese: 观察用过的材料和新物品。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Match each material to an object.
lines.chinese: 把每种材料和对应的物品配对。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: A cardboard box can become a model house.
lines.chinese: 纸箱可以变成房屋模型。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: A plastic bottle can become a piggy bank.
lines.chinese: 塑料瓶可以变成储蓄罐。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Buttons can become a colourful picture.
lines.chinese: 纽扣可以变成一幅彩色图画。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Old jeans can become a small bag.
lines.chinese: 旧牛仔裤可以变成小包。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Show a reused object to your partner.
lines.chinese: 给同伴看一件再利用物品。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Explain which material it uses.
lines.chinese: 说明它用了什么材料。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Prepare a short speech about our shared Earth.
lines.chinese: 准备一段关于共同地球家园的演讲。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Include ideas about your city and green living.
lines.chinese: 加入关于城市和绿色生活的想法。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Talk about useful ways to reuse things.
lines.chinese: 谈谈再利用物品的实用方法。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Complete the speech with your own plans.
lines.chinese: 用自己的计划完成演讲。
